facts.text: NJIT is a public polytechnic research university offering degree programs that span STEM disciplines, architecture, design, management, and humanities.

sources.title: About the University - NJIT Catalog
sources.quote: Continuing a fourfold mission of instruction, research, economic development and public service, NJIT is among the leading comprehensive polytechnic universities in the nation.

sources.title: About the University - NJIT Catalog
sources.quote: NJIT, a top-ranked public research university, offers undergraduate and graduate students over 125 degree programs ranging from the STEM disciplines to architecture and design, as well as management and humanities.
